title: Book Two · Chapter 192: Fourteen Is Not Enough
story:
On the second Wednesday, fourteen reading packets lie in front of Ronan. The work list also says fourteen. Each packet has a number from one to fourteen.

He counts them once and writes fourteen on his slip. Then he starts to put them in number order.

One. Two. Three. He quickly finds the first few packets. At seven, he stops. There are two packets with that number.

He looks through the rest. There is no number eleven.

The count is right. The set is wrong.

Ronan spreads them across the table. He checks the numbers inside, not only the covers. Both sevens contain the same story and questions. Neither packet has the story for number eleven inside.

He puts the second seven aside. He writes THIRTEEN READY on his slip, then adds a note about the missing number.

Miss Wu is busy at the public desk. Ronan uses the work list to check the other packet shelves. He finds no eleven. He looks in the repair tray. A thin packet lies there. Its cover is turned back. The number is inside.

Eleven.

He does not add it to the ready pile. The cover is loose, and someone could lose the first page. He takes his note to Miss Wu when she is free.

“I have thirteen ready packets,” he says. “There are two sevens. Eleven is in the repair tray with a loose cover.”

She comes to look. Ronan shows the two copies of seven and the empty place for eleven.

“Good. Keep eleven out until the cover is secure,” she says. “The younger group can use the thirteen today. I will tell their teacher.”

Ronan puts the ready packets in a shallow box. He leaves a clear gap where eleven should go. He puts his note beside the gap. The spare seven goes in a separate place.

Mei brings the collection sheet. She sees the gap before she sees his note.

“Eleven?” she asks.

“Repair tray. The cover is loose.”

She reads his note and puts the correct number on her sheet. His note explains the problem. Mei does not need to count the whole box again.

At the end of the hour, Ronan's work slip has two numbers. Fourteen packets checked. Thirteen ready. He reads them once more before he signs his name.

On the walk home, he tells Dad about the two sevens. Dad suggests using the spare seven as an eleven with four extra pages.

“The story would be strange,” Ronan says.

“Perhaps the boy could cross the river twice.”

Ronan laughs. He leaves the packet problem at school and asks Dad what is for dinner. Dad says he is hoping for one meal with no missing parts.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

set＝一整套；loose＝松脱的；secure＝固定牢靠的；gap＝空缺。

## 理解问题

1. 为什么总数正确仍不能说明这一套材料齐全？
2. Ronan怎样处理找到了但暂时不能使用的第十一份材料？

## 读句子

**The count is right.**

拆开看：The count / is / right.

总数／是／对的。
